adapter_policy: The S-Story skeleton of a project (user 2026-10-31): its elements, read from the project database through qnc-skeleton-db off the form thread, are source clips laid one after another on one flat timeline and edited as the parts of a SubSegment (qnc-subsegment-edit); every change is written to the skeleton through qnc-skeleton-db at once. Neither the script nor the Story changes. It knows no form.
